name: @ac-components/ac-registro-wizard
description: ac-lit registro-wizard Web Component — componente de referencia del Laboratorio de aprendizaje (catalog-site/), nunca publicado a npm.

scripts.component:build:styles: node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/registro-wizard.styles.scss src/registro-wizard.styles.js RegistroWizardStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/steps/registro-wizard-steps.styles.scss src/elements/steps/registro-wizard-steps.styles.js RegistroWizardStepsStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-datos/registro-wizard-step-datos.styles.scss src/elements/step-datos/registro-wizard-step-datos.styles.js RegistroWizardStepDatosStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-preferencias/registro-wizard-step-preferencias.styles.scss src/elements/step-preferencias/registro-wizard-step-preferencias.styles.js RegistroWizardStepPreferenciasStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-resumen/registro-wizard-step-resumen.styles.scss src/elements/step-resumen/registro-wizard-step-resumen.styles.js RegistroWizardStepResumenStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/modal-resultado/registro-wizard-modal-resultado.styles.scss src/elements/modal-resultado/registro-wizard-modal-resultado.styles.js RegistroWizardModalResultadoStyles && node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/modal-info/registro-wizard-modal-info.styles.scss src/elements/modal-info/registro-wizard-modal-info.styles.js RegistroWizardModalInfoStyles
scripts.component:build:styles:watch: concurrently -k -n main,steps,datos,prefs,resumen,modal,info -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,gray "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/registro-wizard.styles.scss src/registro-wizard.styles.js RegistroWizardStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/steps/registro-wizard-steps.styles.scss src/elements/steps/registro-wizard-steps.styles.js RegistroWizardStepsStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-datos/registro-wizard-step-datos.styles.scss src/elements/step-datos/registro-wizard-step-datos.styles.js RegistroWizardStepDatosStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-preferencias/registro-wizard-step-preferencias.styles.scss src/elements/step-preferencias/registro-wizard-step-preferencias.styles.js RegistroWizardStepPreferenciasStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/step-resumen/registro-wizard-step-resumen.styles.scss src/elements/step-resumen/registro-wizard-step-resumen.styles.js RegistroWizardStepResumenStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/modal-resultado/registro-wizard-modal-resultado.styles.scss src/elements/modal-resultado/registro-wizard-modal-resultado.styles.js RegistroWizardModalResultadoStyles --watch" "node ./node_modules/@ac-base/cli/scripts/compile-scss-to-lit.cjs src/elements/modal-info/registro-wizard-modal-info.styles.scss src/elements/modal-info/registro-wizard-modal-info.styles.js RegistroWizardModalInfoStyles --watch"
scripts.component:serve: pnpm run component:build:styles && concurrently -k -n styles,vite -c blue,green "pnpm run component:build:styles:watch" "vite demo"
scripts.component:test:e2e: pnpm run component:build && start-server-and-test component:preview http://localhost:4173 component:test:e2e:run
scripts.component:test:e2e:a11y: pnpm run component:build && start-server-and-test component:preview http://localhost:4173 component:test:e2e:a11y:run
